# NSF Restricted Entities Guide (Independent)

> An independent, static guide to the 13 U.S. restricted party lists named in Appendix A of
> NSF's Dear Colleague Letter of July 8, 2026, "Prohibition on Collaborations with Restricted
> Entities". 5,929 entries extracted from the official publications, searchable in one place.
> Not an NSF or U.S. government website, not a compliance determination, and not legal advice.

Site: https://curtishoffmann.com/nsfreg/
Maintainer: Curtis Hoffmann (https://curtishoffmann.com)
Snapshot retrieved: 2026-07-09
Source repository: https://github.com/phagehunter/nsfreg

## Pages

- https://curtishoffmann.com/nsfreg/: search all 5,929 entries across every list in the snapshot.
- https://curtishoffmann.com/nsfreg/policy.html: what the Dear Colleague Letter prohibits, who certifies, and the FY2027 dates.
- https://curtishoffmann.com/nsfreg/lists.html: one explainer per list, with legal basis, update cadence and official link.
- https://curtishoffmann.com/nsfreg/faq.html: plain-language answers for researchers and research administrators.
- https://curtishoffmann.com/nsfreg/checklist.html: preparation checklists for researchers and for institutions.
- https://curtishoffmann.com/nsfreg/about.html: provenance, per-list snapshot dates, methodology and known gaps.

## The lists in this snapshot

- Sec. 1260H List (Chinese Military Companies) (DoW): 80 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/search?conditions%5Bsearch_type_id%5D=3&conditions%5Bterm%5D=1260H
- Sec. 1286 List (Academic Institutions) (DoW): 134 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://basicresearch.defense.gov/Programs/Academic-Research-Security/
- Entity List (Commerce/BIS): 3,409 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-15/subtitle-B/chapter-VII/subchapter-C/part-744#Supplement-No.-4-to-Part-744
- Military End-User (MEU) List (Commerce/BIS): 70 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-15/subtitle-B/chapter-VII/subchapter-C/part-744/appendix-Supplement%20No.%207%20to%20Part%20744
- Denied Persons List (Commerce/BIS): 564 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.bis.gov/licensing/end-user-guidance/denied-persons-list-dpl
- E.O. 14032 Annex (Treasury/OFAC): 59 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://ofac.treasury.gov/media/99111/download?inline
- NS-CMIC List (Treasury/OFAC): 68 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.treasury.gov/ofac/downloads/ccmc/nscmiclist.pdf
- Debarred Parties (Statutory) (State/DDTC): 779 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://deccspmddtc.servicenowservices.com/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=c22d1833dbb8d300d0a370131f9619f0
- Debarred Parties (Administrative) (State/DDTC): 8 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://deccspmddtc.servicenowservices.com/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=c22d1833dbb8d300d0a370131f9619f0
- Nonproliferation Sanctions (State/ISN): 528 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.state.gov/bureau-of-arms-control-and-nonproliferation/nonproliferation-sanctions
- FCC Covered List (FCC): 15 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.fcc.gov/supplychain/coveredlist
- UFLPA Entity List (DHS): 148 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.dhs.gov/uflpa-entity-list
- Withhold Release Orders & Findings (CBP): 67 entries, retrieved 2026-07-09, official source https://www.cbp.gov/document/stats/withhold-release-orders-findings

## How the data was produced

Each list was extracted from its official publication by a script in pipeline/ and stored as JSON in
data/. build.py computes every count on the site from those files; no figure on a page is typed by
hand. Designation status for the State nonproliferation list is derived from the per-measure status
clauses carried in each record's own notes field.

## Limits a reader should know

- A snapshot, not the live lists. Several sources change monthly or more often.
- A non-match is not a clearance. Names vary by translation, abbreviation and subsidiary.
- Entities are grouped across lists by exact normalized name only.
- PDF-derived lists can carry extraction artifacts, especially in transliterated names.
